LanguageData.RR_RestingGainCondition: Active only while an eligible adult actually lies in this bed, awake or asleep. Adds to the weight-gain multiplier when surplus energy is converted into body mass. For example, a 100% multiplier becomes 125% with a Normal bed. Does not create food, affect weight loss, or apply just from owning the bed. Maximum contribution: +50%.
LanguageData.RR_SmockCookingCondition: Multiplies final cooking speed while worn. A Normal smock multiplies it by 115%; a Legendary smock by 130%. If multiple smocks are equipped, only the strongest bonus applies. Requires Kitchen workwear research; make at either tailoring bench.
LanguageData.RR_NovaQualityCondition: Active while worn by an eligible adult. Quality scales this item's special bonus, not the pawn's entire stat. Compatible pieces combine using the normal RimRound stacking rules. Mitigation remains bounded by the pawn's normal mitigation limits.
LanguageData.RR_LegacyEquipmentCondition: Legacy Perks mode preserves the base profile recorded when this item was equipped. Quality adds a live adjustment without changing the saved bonus ledger.
